## Checklist

- [ ] Change is within the linked spec's scope; out-of-scope findings are listed as follow-ups
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion in the spec is covered by a test
- [ ] Spec `status` is up to date and no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers remain
- [ ] Docs and READMEs describe the resulting behavior
- [ ] ADR added for architecture-relevant decisions
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tenant/subscription IDs, real hostnames, or production URLs
- [ ] No remote environments were mutated without explicit instruction
- [ ] CI pipelines added or updated where required
